tools.description: Lists what the site sent that Echo captured (email, SMS, webhooks, chat, analytics, payments), newest first: one line of fields per message. Use get_message for the whole message.

action.description: Only messages from this action ID (as in a run: action:checkout).

run.description: Only messages from this run ID.

since.description: Only messages captured since then: a duration back from now ("15m", "2h") or an RFC 3339 time.

to.description: Only messages to a recipient containing this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: list_messages
tools.title: List captured messages

tools.description: Returns one captured message with every field: recipients, subject, text, HTML, headers, body and Echo's answer. "latest" is the newest.

id.description: The message ID from list_messages, or "latest".

tools.name: get_message
tools.title: Get one message

tools.description: Finds the newest email or SMS with a one-time code (login, sign-up, 2FA) and returns the code alone.

since.description: Only messages captured since then: a duration back from now ("15m", "2h") or an RFC 3339 time.

to.description: Only messages to a recipient containing this text.

tools.name: latest_code
tools.title: Latest one-time code

tools.description: Runs actions from .echo/config.yaml against the site (form posts, commands, replayed webhooks) and returns what each sent and the issues found.

actions.description: Names of actions in .echo/config.yaml to run; all of them when empty.

tools.name: run_action
tools.title: Run actions

tools.description: Runs the actions and saves what they sent as a snapshot, the baseline compare checks against. Take one before a change.

actions.description: Names of actions in .echo/config.yaml to run; all of them when empty.

name.description: Snapshot name: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores (default: the time).

tools.name: snapshot
tools.title: Take a snapshot

tools.description: Runs the actions again and compares what they sent with a snapshot: what broke, what is new, what changed, what was fixed.

actions.description: Names of actions in .echo/config.yaml to run; all of them when empty.

tools.name: compare
tools.title: Compare with a snapshot

tools.description: Checks the DNS records mail from a domain depends on (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI) and returns them with the issues found.

domain.description: The domain mail comes from, like shop.com.

provider.description: The service that sends its mail, when known: sendgrid, mailgun, ses, postmark…

tools.name: check_domain
tools.title: Check a sending domain
